title: Among all British constructors who have participated in races between 2000
question: Among all British constructors who have participated in races between 2000 and 2010, identify the one with the highest total points across those years. Then, find the youngest driver (by date of birth) who ever drove for that constructor in any race during the same period and finished the race.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_british_constructor AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_022 AS constructor_id
    FROM constructors c
    JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.XCL_022 = cr.XCL_012
    JOIN races r ON cr.XCL_011 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE c.XCL_025 = 'British'
      AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
    GROUP BY c.XCL_022
    ORDER BY SUM(cr.XCL_013) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
JOIN status s ON res.XCL_090 = s.XCL_093
WHERE res.XCL_076 = (SELECT constructor_id FROM top_british_constructor)
  AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
  AND s.XCL_094 = 'Finished'
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH top_british_constructor AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_022 AS constructor_id
    FROM constructors c
    JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.XCL_022 = cr.XCL_012
    JOIN races r ON cr.XCL_011 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE c.XCL_025 = 'British'
      AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
    GROUP BY c.XCL_022
    ORDER BY SUM(cr.XCL_013) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
JOIN status s ON res.XCL_090 = s.XCL_093
WHERE res.XCL_076 = (SELECT constructor_id FROM top_british_constructor)
  AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
  AND s.XCL_094 = 'Finished'
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC
LIMIT 1
